scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run desktop:native:dev"
scripts.dev:desktop:electron: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && electron desktop/main.cjs"
scripts.launch:web: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && node scripts/open-url.mjs http://localhost:4200"
scripts.launch:admin: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4201/admin && node scripts/open-url.mjs http://localhost:4201/admin"
scripts.launch:all: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4201/admin && node scripts/open-url.mjs http://localhost:4200 http://localhost:4201/admin" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run desktop:native:dev"
scripts.launch:tunnel: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run tunnel"
scripts.launch:tuna: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run tuna"
scripts.launch:cloudflare: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && npm run tunnel:cloudflare"
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && npm run android:apk:debug
